name: jacky_weitian_wu_ats
description: Single column for Weitian Wu: a Georgia serif face, a letter-spaced name over a double rule, headings underlined to their own width in navy, and square bullets - visibly unlike the other profiles' templates while keeping what makes a resume parse: one column, real separators between fields, ordinary headings in the order summary, education, skills, experience, list bullets, and no icons, tables or fills.
htmlContent:
{{name}}
{{title}}
{{contact.phone}} | {{contact.email}}{{#if contact.linkedin}} | {{contact.linkedin}}{{/if}}{{#if contact.github}} | {{contact.github}}{{/if}}{{#if contact.portfolio}} | {{contact.portfolio}}{{/if}} | {{contact.location}}
Professional Summary
{{summary}}
Education
{{#each education}}
{{degree}}
{{institution}}{{#if location}} | {{location}}{{/if}} | {{startDate}} - {{endDate}}{{#if gpa}} | GPA: {{gpa}}{{/if}}

{{category}}
{{join skills ", "}}
{{/each}}{{else}}{{#if hardSkills.length}}{{#each hardSkills}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{else}}{{#each skills}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/if}}{{/if}}

{{title}} | {{company}}
